finalText:
**Redis died, and the app never recovered from it.**

Timeline from `logs/app.log`:

```
02:14:07  redis connection lost — ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379
02:14:08  cache bypassed, every read hits the store
02:14:10  first 5s timeouts, queue depth 52
02:29:12  queue depth 502, past the 500 cap
02:31:44  worker-2 dies: JavaScript heap out of memory
02:31:52  supervisor kills the process group — service down
```

Before 02:14 everything was fine. Cache hits sat near 0.95.

The last good request was at `02:14:03`. Nothing succeeded after that.

Redis never came back. 13 reconnect tries, all refused, one every 80 seconds. Fixed spacing, so no backoff. The queue had no cap that actually stopped work, so it grew until memory ran out.

Worth fixing next: make cache misses fail fast instead of piling up, and make that 500 limit shed load.
